cursor.instructionsFileHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the prompt at runtime.

grok-local.instructionsFileHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Myrmidon stages it into the Grok workspace as Agents.md when possible.

kimi-local.instructionsFileHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Prepended to the Kimi prompt at runtime.

fields.instructionsFileHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime.

advanced.engineHint: Default uses ACP. If ACP is unavailable, the run fails with a setup error. Choose CLI explicitly to use it.
advanced.acpCommandHint: Optional override for the Claude ACP server command. Defaults to the package-local claude-agent-acp binary.
advanced.acpModeHint: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.
advanced.acpPermissionsHint: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.
advanced.acpStateDirHint: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Myrmidon-managed organization/agent scoped storage.
advanced.acpWarmIdleHint: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.

gemini-local.instructionsFileHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Prepended to the Gemini prompt at runtime.
gemini-local.engineHint: Default uses ACP. If ACP is unavailable, the run fails with a setup error. Choose CLI explicitly to use it.
gemini-local.acpCommandHint: Optional override for the Gemini ACP server command. Defaults to gemini --acp.
gemini-local.acpModeHint: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.
gemini-local.acpPermissionsHint: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.
gemini-local.acpStateDirHint: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Myrmidon-managed organization/agent scoped storage.
gemini-local.acpWarmIdleHint: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.

codex-local.instructionsFileHint: Absolute path to a markdown file (e.g. AGENTS.md) that defines this agent's behavior. Injected into the system prompt at runtime. Note: Codex may still auto-apply repo-scoped AGENTS.md files from the workspace.
codex-local.engineHint: Default uses ACP. If ACP is unavailable, the run fails with a setup error. Choose CLI explicitly to use it.
codex-local.acpCommandHint: Optional override for the Codex ACP server command. Defaults to the package-local codex-acp binary.
codex-local.acpModeHint: Persistent keeps ACP session state between runs. One-shot starts fresh each run.
codex-local.acpPermissionsHint: Fallback if the ACP agent asks for input outside an interactive session.
codex-local.acpStateDirHint: Optional ACP session state directory. Defaults to Myrmidon-managed organization/agent scoped storage.
codex-local.acpWarmIdleHint: Defaults to 0, which closes the ACP process after each run while retaining persistent session state.
codex-local.fastModeManual: Fast mode will be passed through for this manual model. If Codex rejects it, turn the toggle off.
codex-local.fastModeCredits: Fast mode consumes credits/tokens much faster than standard Codex runs.
codex-local.fastModeUnsupported: Fast mode currently only works on {{models}} or manual model IDs. Myrmidon will ignore this toggle until the model is switched.
codex-local.providerHint: The runner persists this provider with each run so recovery cannot drift after configuration changes.
codex-local.managedProfileHint: Company-scoped qualified profile ID or key. Remote resource identity is loaded from the stored profile, not this agent config.
codex-local.sessionCeilingHint: Optional per-agent hard ceiling. Leave 1.00 to use a conservative default.
codex-local.managedRetentionHint: Claude Managed is a stateful beta service and is not eligible for ZDR or HIPAA modes.
codex-local.agentCoreProfileHint: Company-scoped qualified profile ID or key. Harness, Memory, IAM, and context-store identity come from the stored profile.
codex-local.estimatedCeilingHint: Myrmidon estimate; AWS does not provide a per-session currency hard stop.
codex-local.maxIterationsHint: Qualified range is 1–8. Invalid values fail closed to 8.
codex-local.agentCoreRetentionHint: The qualified AgentCore profile retains short-term Memory events for exactly 90 days.
codex-local.permissionModeHint: {{description}} The selected mode does not widen Myrmidon's workspace, network, credential, or planning boundaries. It also cannot relax the myrmidon(1.6-AUTONOMY) role × action-class gate: that server-side gate is stronger than any mode chosen here and denies or holds actions independently of this setting.
codex-local.permissionModeUnsupported: Unsupported saved mode — select a qualified mode
codex-local.permissionModeCodexAlert: This saved Codex mode cannot start or recover a Myrmidon Runner run. Select Automatic (isolated) to remediate it.
codex-local.lifecycleHint: Turn by turn suspends after each run. Warm keeps the same provider process available between governed runs.
codex-local.warmIdleTimeoutHint: After this much inactivity, runnerd checkpoints and suspends the provider session. The maximum is 24 hours.

secretField.storedPlaceholder: Stored secret; enter a new value to replace it

fields.apiBaseUrlHint: Hermes API server base URL that Myrmidon can reach, such as http://127.0.0.1:8642 or a private HTTPS URL. Default dashboard root/chat URLs such as http://127.0.0.1:9119/chat are accepted and map to /api.
fields.myrmidonApiUrlHint: Optional Myrmidon API URL reachable by the Hermes host. This is not a credential.
fields.sessionKeyStrategyHint: Controls X-Hermes-Session-Key. Issue scoped prevents cross-task memory bleed by default.
fields.eventReconnectHint: Delay before reconnecting the Hermes SSE events stream after a nonterminal disconnect.
fields.allowRemoteHttpHint: Unsafe dev-only escape hatch. Remote Hermes gateways should use HTTPS; loopback HTTP remains allowed.
fields.extraHeadersHint: Optional JSON object of extra nonsecret headers. Security-critical headers are generated by the adapter.
fields.instructionsHint: Optional stable Hermes instructions sent separately from the wake input.

fields.deviceAuthDescription: When enabled, Myrmidon persists a device key during onboarding so pairing approvals remain stable across runs.
